rationale: The workflow re-fetches and installs R dependencies (via setup-r-dependencies) plus a Miniconda/TensorFlow environment on every run, which is repeated dependency fetching. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) supports adding a dependency cache before installation, keyed on the dependency manifest, while keeping installation and all required tests. Preconditions are met: dependency fetching happens every run and DESCRIPTION serves as the cache input; no contraindication applies (no equivalent cache exists, content is pinned). A cache step for the R package library is inserted after setup-r and before setup-r-dependencies, keyed on hashFiles('DESCRIPTION'), so a changed DESCRIPTION invalidates the cache and a full reinstall still occurs. All original steps, triggers, permissions, and the build/deploy coverage are preserved unchanged; no secrets, privileged actions, publishing changes, or new network access are added.
